'''Isk''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], trained since his birth as a [[Force Hound]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. He was a servant of [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] and was defeated by [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] in the [[Arena of Byss]] during a fight to the Death. Isk begged Xesh to kill him, but he refused. Skal'nas subsequently ordered Isk to be killed and prepared for his consumption.

==Personality and traits==
Isk had azure [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on the body representing the letter [[Isk/Legends|Isk]] of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet.
